items.title: United Airlines’ CEO Wants The U.S. To Fund SAF Like It Funded Solar
items.summary: Supply chain woes have long blocked the uptake of SAF, but United Airlines’ Scott Kirby sees potential in corn and soy currently grown for biodiesel. He wants more government support to firm up the industry — but criticized Europe’s approach.

items.title: Why the Personal AI Assistant Hype Matters More for Travel Than Any AI Travel Product
items.summary: The biggest shift in AI travel may be happening outside travel, as general-purpose agents learn to book, rebook, and act for the customer.

items.title: European Vacation Rental Platform Awaze Felt Affordability Squeeze in 2025
items.summary: Europe's largest holiday-rental group grew adjusted earnings and narrowed its loss in 2025, but revenue slipped, its cash position shrunk, and the group slid into net liabilities ahead of a 2028 refinancing.

items.title: Klook Bets Creators Can Sell the Whole Trip, Not Just the Viral Attraction
items.summary: The social media influencer’s “Like, Comment and Share” button just got a new friend… Meet the “Book” link.

items.title: What Hurricane Season Means For Hospitality’s Capex
items.summary: Host Hotels & Resorts’ $105 million work on The Don CeSar puts a real number on the cost of hurricane repairs and preparedness — but, as the company notes, investing in resilience doesn’t reduce risk to zero.

items.title: Google Strips Out EU Travel Search Features to Avoid More Fines
items.summary: Google is scaling back certain search features in Europe as DMA enforcement escalates.

items.title: Inside the Financial Engineering of Club Med’s IPO
items.summary: Club Med wants to grow from 69 resorts to about 85 without owning the next wave, and its new financial structure helps explain why.

items.title: Luxury+Lifestyle: Can a Small Collection of Iconic London Hotels Out-Earn Big Brands?
items.summary: The owner of The Connaught and The Berkeley has hired the man who scaled Six Senses to build an operating company for luxury lifestyle hotels it owns and doesn't own.
